dashboard.title: How do you want to play today?
dashboard.oraculo_desc: One card a day. No commitment.
dashboard.viaje_desc: 20 days with yourself. A real process.
dashboard.prepared: Here's what's prepared for you today.
dashboard.empty: Nothing is prepared for you yet. Check back soon.

viaje.start_desc: A real process. Three cards each day: morning, midday and night. No shortcuts.
viaje.start_how_1: 20 days with yourself. A process, not a game. Go at your pace, no skipping steps.
viaje.start_how_2: Each day, three cards: morning, midday and night. Each one opens at its hour.
viaje.start_how_3: You move through four phases: Awaken, Descend, Cross and Return.
viaje.start_how_4: From each card you keep one word. At the end you'll have the full map of your journey.
viaje.umbral_1: Standing up, write: «What I fear most to find here is…»
viaje.umbral_2: Read out loud the Descend card that shook you most.
viaje.umbral_3: Write an excuse you've used your whole life. Cross it out.

paso.intro_desc: It does not try to define who you are. It shows how you move today and where you may be leaving yourself behind.
paso.intro_how: You'll see 28 groups of four phrases. In each one, mark the one CLOSEST to you and the one that's LEAST. Even if none fits perfectly, pick the closest: it's a comparison, not a label. There are no right or wrong answers.
paso.intro_reassurance: There are no correct answers. Your result reflects this moment and can always change.
paso.example_intro: First choose what you like most, then what you like least.
paso.example_step_more: Start by choosing the option you like MOST.
paso.example_step_less: Good. Now choose a different option under LEAST.
paso.example_done: Perfect. That is the whole gesture you need.
paso.test_prompt: Which one is CLOSEST to you, and which is LEAST? Even if none defines you fully, pick the closest.
paso.test_step_more: First choose the statement that is MOST like you.
paso.test_step_more_missing: Now choose the statement that is MOST like you.
paso.test_step_less: Good. Now choose a different statement under LEAST.
paso.pattern_framing: There are 15 types of Walkers. This one is yours.
paso.result_classification_intro: Your Walker type describes your general way of moving through life. But the test also reaches nuances that are uniquely yours: the particular combination of Press on, Accompany, Sustain and Observe drawn by your answers.
paso.result_distance_title: Your visible style and your natural tendency
paso.result_distance_intro: This chart compares two layers of how you act. The orange line represents what you make visible: the behaviours you use and reinforce in response to your environment. The green line represents your more spontaneous tendency: what usually appears when you do not need to adapt or meet an expectation.
paso.result_profile_title: Your way of walking, up close
paso.result_profile_intro: What drives you, what happens as pressure rises, and the learning that may help you walk with greater freedom.
paso.classification_acronym_intro: PASO brings together four ways of acting. All four are present in you; the chart shows how they combine at this point in time.
paso.classification_reading_title: What each letter in PASO means
paso.classification_reading_note: Position does not indicate ability or worth. Further right is not better, and further left is not a deficiency: it shows which resource you tend to activate more or less often. The centre represents balanced use within the model.
paso.dim_P_desc: Your disposition to decide, set a direction and act even when some uncertainty remains.
paso.dim_P_example: For example: when progress stalls, you tend to make a decision that gets things moving again.
paso.dim_A_desc: How you connect, express what you think and involve other people in what is happening.
paso.dim_A_example: For example: when an idea emerges, you look to share it and build engagement around it.
paso.dim_S_desc: Your capacity to maintain a pace, provide continuity and sustain people or processes over time.
paso.dim_S_example: For example: when change occurs, you try to preserve calm and keep the process stable.
paso.dim_O_desc: Your tendency to observe, compare information and protect accuracy before accepting something as sound.
paso.dim_O_example: For example: before deciding, you review the details and consider the possible consequences.
paso.dim_P_high: Press on stands out: you tend to decide, set a direction and get things moving.
paso.dim_P_balance: Press on is balanced: you take the initiative when needed without having to direct every situation.
paso.dim_P_low: Press on stays in the background: you tend to allow space or gather more input before taking the lead.
paso.dim_A_high: Accompany stands out: relationships, expression and involving other people carry considerable weight in how you act.
paso.dim_A_balance: Accompany is balanced: you can rely on others without always needing their participation or approval.
paso.dim_A_low: Accompany stays in the background: you tend to preserve your autonomy and avoid making every step depend on connection with others.
paso.dim_S_high: Sustain stands out: you value continuity, calm and stability over abrupt changes of pace.
paso.dim_S_balance: Sustain is balanced: you can remain consistent and also change pace when the situation calls for it.
paso.dim_S_low: Sustain stays in the background: changing pace or seeking movement comes more naturally than preserving stability.
paso.dim_O_high: Observe stands out: you tend to compare, review and seek precision before considering something sufficiently sound.
paso.dim_O_balance: Observe is balanced: you analyse what is needed without requiring every detail to be settled before moving forward.
paso.dim_O_low: Observe stays in the background: you tend to trust action or intuition more than prolonged analysis.
paso.que_es_intro: PASO doesn't tell you who you are. It looks at how you walk through life through four ways of moving. None is better than another: we all carry the four, in different measure.
paso.que_es_P: How you decide and move forward: the drive to choose a direction and push toward it.
paso.que_es_A: How you relate: how much you walk with others and need their company.
paso.que_es_S: How you hold your pace: the calm and steadiness to keep going.
paso.que_es_O: How you read the terrain: how much you observe and weigh before taking the step.
paso.curva_hint: Orange: what you show. Green: what comes with less effort. The closeness or distance between the lines indicates how similar those two layers are in each dimension.
paso.distance_mask_text: We use mask to mean the style you make visible. It does not mean you are pretending or hiding who you are: it includes behaviours you have learnt to activate in order to navigate, protect yourself or respond to what a situation requires.
paso.distance_reading_text: When the lines are close, your visible behaviour and spontaneous tendency are largely aligned. When they separate, an area of adaptation appears: you may be showing more of a trait than comes naturally, or containing something that is part of you. Distance is neither good nor bad; what matters is whether it helps you or whether maintaining it asks too much of you.
paso.firma_desc: This is how your way of walking is distributed today. The centre marks balance; each direction shows how present each form is in you.
paso.separas_title: When the outside and inside do not quite match
paso.separas_gap: The biggest gap is in «{dim}». It's the distance between what you show on the outside and the terrain you carry inside.
paso.dir_exige: you push it more on the outside than comes naturally
paso.dir_esconde: it is more present inside than you let others see
paso.dir_alineado: what you show and what comes naturally go hand in hand
paso.book: The book that resonates most with you
paso.nota_espejo: PASO isn't a scientific test or a diagnosis. It's a mirror: what your answers draw, a direction to look at yourself. It doesn't say who you are, but how you walk today — and that can always change.
paso.cta_account: Create a free account to save your result and keep exploring the method.
paso.pdf_hint: A PDF file containing your report will be downloaded.
paso.share_text: My way of walking in PASO: “{patron}”. Discover yours:
paso.pdf_footer: Discover how you walk at www.ikigaier.com
paso.rareza_habitual: A less common way of walking
paso.mapa_intro: Yours is marked. How common each one is is only an approximation, and none is better than another: we all carry some of the four.
